explanation_full: At the L2-L3 level, the analysis focuses on the relative importance and variability of the features. This high variability suggests that Propionate levels are highly diverse across the samples. Furthermore, the mean values for other features like Ethanol (0.1016) and Acetate (0.0546) are significantly lower, implying that Propionate's distribution is the primary driver of feature variation in this dataset.
